hello_text: NorkaOS is installed. Let's grab the programs you need, it takes a couple of minutes. You can always do it later in Norka Center.
norka_text: Norka lives on your desktop: click her, she sleeps at night and sweats when the computer works hard.
norka_corner: Put Norka back in the corner
norka_hint: Meta+N hides and shows Norka. Later it will open a chat with her.
panel_text: Where the panel lives and how it looks.
panel_floating: Floating, with a gap from the screen edge
apps_text: Tick what you want, Norka will install it. Needs the internet.
apps_failed: Something did not install. Check the internet and try again.
app_video_hint: OBS for recording, Kdenlive for editing
tip_menu: The Meta key (with the Windows logo) opens the menu.
tip_norka: Meta+N hides me if I'm in the way.
tip_snapshots: Before every update I take a snapshot. If something breaks, pick it in the boot menu.
tip_center: Settings for me and the panel are in Norka Center.
snap_text: Before every update NorkaOS saves a copy of the system. If an update breaks something, go back to the copy. Your files in the home folder are not touched.
snap_empty: No snapshots yet: they appear with the first update.
snap_confirm: Go back to snapshot #%1? Programs and settings will be as they were then. Your files stay.
snap_rolled: Done. Restart the computer to finish.
snap_broken: After going back, the old system is still kept and takes space.
about_text: A cosy furry Linux system. Made with love, open source, no telemetry.
